title: fix: track key-budget referral arrivals
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fixes missing arrival analytics for the `agent_key_budget` links introduced in #14740 by allowing the tag in both the browser beacon and referral API.
- Reuses the existing `metadata.logged_in` tracking and Tinybird schema; adds signed-in and signed-out coverage through the existing referral test cases.
- Validation: CI Enter tests/typecheck, frontend lint/build, and CodeQL pass. Local Biome, TypeScript, and two focused tests also pass; the full local run was blocked by DNS during the existing GitHub username-sync flow.

gist.headline: The referral trail reconnects
gist.blurb: Agent key-budget links now leave the same little trail of pollen as the rest of the garden. Signed-in and signed-out arrivals are both counted again.
gist.summary: Fixed arrival analytics for `agent_key_budget` referral links by allowing the tag through both the frontend browser beacon and Enter referral API while retaining the existing `metadata.logged_in` and Tinybird schema.
gist.impact: Builders sharing `agent_key_budget` links can now see referral arrivals recorded consistently for both signed-in and signed-out visitors.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny trail-mapping gardener, following a lime-green path from a key-shaped budget sign to a cozy CRT analytics monitor. Small logged-in and logged-out visitor sprites arrive along the path while flowers and code-plants mark each correctly tracked visit.

Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, dark purple (#110518) outlines, emotionally warm and nostalgic.
